title: OmniProject GTD task-context vocabulary entry
description: One canonical GTD @context (David Allen's "where / with what tool can I do this" axis — a FLAT set, unlike the ordinal energy/severity axes), authored as a single JSON array (assets/task-context-vocabulary.json), validated element-by-element against this schema and embedded by gen-task-context-vocabulary. A context has a display `order` but no internal ordinal `level` — it is a set, not a scale.

labels.description: Optional per-locale translations of the label (BCP-47 key → text). A viewer sees labels[theirLocale] ?? labels[lang] ?? label.

order.description: Display position — the only ordinal a context carries (there is no internal `level`; contexts are an unordered set).

color.description: Swatch colour as a 6-digit hex (rendered via inline style). Absent ⇒ a neutral swatch.

methodologies.description: Methodology tags this context belongs to ('*' = neutral / all). Absent ⇒ neutral.
